Note · Endovascular robotics笔记 · 血管介入机器人

How to calculate the needed catheter/guidewire length for your endovascular robot?如何计算血管介入机器人所需的导管/导丝长度？

Weibo Gao · October 2026Weibo Gao · 2026 年 10 月

An endovascular robot that grips catheters and guidewires outside the patient has a hidden cost. Every centimetre of an instrument held inside the robot can never enter the patient. Neurovascular devices are sized for hand use, with only about 5–15 cm to spare at the proximal end, so this loss often decides whether an instrument reaches its target at all.血管介入机器人在患者体外夹持导管和导丝。器械留在机器人里的那一段，永远进不了患者体内。神经介入器械的长度是按手工操作设计的，近端通常只富余 5–15 cm，所以这段损失常常决定了器械能不能到达目标。

With coaxial instruments in a modular robot such as our LegoBot, the loss compounds. The instrument gripped by the k-th module from the patient passes through k modules and the k−1 gaps between them. If an outer catheter is longer than it needs to be, its extra length is passed on to every instrument inside it. With 19 cm modules and 12 cm gaps, a 132 cm aspiration catheter driven by the second module reaches only the carotid bifurcation, not the MCA.在 LegoBot 这样的模块化机器人里，器械一根套一根，损失会逐层累加。从患者一侧数，第 k 个模块夹持的器械要穿过 k 个模块，以及它们之间的 k−1 段间隙。外层导管如果比需要的长，多出来的长度还会转给套在里面的每一根器械。按每个模块 19 cm、间隙 12 cm 算，由第二个模块驱动的 132 cm 抽吸导管只能到颈动脉分叉，到不了大脑中动脉。

Checking a device set by hand means tracking, for every instrument, the length left inside the robot, the slack inherited from outer layers, where its tip must end up, and the vessel path length from the access site to that point. This page does that bookkeeping. Set your robot's geometry, access route and device stack, and it reports each instrument's required length, its margin and the deepest landmark it can reach. LegoBot (Gao et al., IEEE/ASME T-MECH 2026) is the worked example; for other proximally driven robots, including cassette-based systems, set the module length and gap to match your drive.手工核算一套器械，每一根都要算清四个量：留在机器人里的长度、从外层继承的余长、头端最终停在哪里，以及从穿刺点到那里的血管路径长度。这个页面替你算这笔账。填入机器人的几何参数、入路和器械组合，页面会给出每根器械所需的长度、余量，以及它最深能到达的解剖位置。示例用的是 LegoBot（Gao 等，IEEE/ASME T-MECH 2026）。其他在近端驱动器械的机器人，包括卡盒式系统，把模块长度和间隙换成自己驱动装置的数值就可以用。

Required lengthk = depth to target + sheath hub + free span + k·Lm + (k−1)·g + slack of outer catheters所需长度k = 体内深度 + 鞘 hub + 游离段 + k·Lm + (k−1)·g + 外层导管余长

Robot geometry机器人几何参数

The CAD option charges one extra gap g to every catheter except the innermost instrument.选 CAD 方式时，除最内层器械外，每根导管多算一段间隙 g。

An outer catheter longer than it needs to be leaves extra shaft between the robot and its hub. Every instrument inside it has to travel that extra distance too.外层导管比需要的长时，多出的管身会留在机器人和它的 hub 之间，套在里面的每根器械都要多走这一段。

Inside the robot: where working length is lost机器人内部：工作长度损失在哪里

This is the 6-DOF assembly from CAD (STEP, December 2025), with the three instruments drawn along the centerline measured from the CAD tubes. The instruments run coaxially. The guide catheter is gripped in the purple module, the microcatheter in the white module, and the guidewire in the gold module. Every millimetre between the patient-side face of the first module and an instrument's hub stays inside the robot and can never enter the patient. That is the instrument's lost working length. Pick an instrument to highlight its lost length.这是 CAD 里的 6 自由度装配体（STEP，2025 年 12 月）。三根器械沿 CAD 管件量出的中心线画出，彼此同轴：导引导管由紫色模块夹持，微导管由白色模块夹持，导丝由金色模块夹持。从第一个模块朝向患者的端面，到某根器械的 hub，这一段始终留在机器人里，进不了患者体内，也就是这根器械损失的工作长度。选一根器械，就能高亮它损失的那一段。

How the October 2026 instrument sets were chosen2026 年 10 月的几套器械是怎么选出来的

  1. List the instrument stack for each procedure. For angiography, aspiration thrombectomy and aneurysm coiling we wrote down every coaxial instrument used clinically, where it enters and where its tip stops. For example, in thrombectomy the guide stops in the distal cervical ICA, the aspiration catheter at the clot face in M1, and the wire in M2.列出每种手术的器械组合。对造影、抽吸取栓和动脉瘤栓塞，我们列出了临床上用到的每一根同轴器械，以及它从哪里进入、头端停在哪里。以取栓为例：导引导管停在颈内动脉颈段远端，抽吸导管停在 M1 的血栓表面，导丝到 M2。
  2. Estimate depth inside the body. We estimated the vessel path length from the femoral puncture to each target for an average adult: about 85 cm to the cervical ICA and 102 cm to M1. We added 12 cm for tall patients or a Type III arch. These are estimates and should be replaced with phantom or CTA centerline measurements.估计体内深度。按成年人平均身材，估计从股动脉穿刺点到各目标的血管路径长度：到颈内动脉颈段约 85 cm，到 M1 约 102 cm。高个子或 III 型主动脉弓再加 12 cm。这些都是估计值，应该换成在模型或 CTA 上量到的中心线长度。
  3. Model what the robot consumes. An instrument gripped by the k-th module from the patient passes through k modules and k−1 gaps between them. With LegoBot's Lm = 19 cm and g = 12 cm, that is 19, 50, 81 and 112 cm for k = 1 to 4. For example, the middle catheter in a 3-module stack loses 2 × 19 + 12 = 50 cm.算出机器人用掉的长度。从患者一侧数第 k 个模块夹持的器械，要穿过 k 个模块和它们之间的 k−1 段间隙。按 LegoBot 的 Lm = 19 cm、g = 12 cm，k = 1 到 4 分别损失 19、50、81 和 112 cm。比如 3 模块组合里中间那根导管，损失 2 × 19 + 12 = 50 cm。
  4. Compare with commercial lengths. Required length = depth + sheath hub (3 cm) + free span + robot loss. Standard neuro devices came up 20–50 cm short at the middle catheter layers: a 132 cm aspiration catheter at k = 2 only reaches about 79 cm, near the carotid bifurcation. Guidewires were fine once we switched to 300 cm exchange length.和市售长度对比。所需长度 = 体内深度 + 鞘 hub（3 cm）+ 游离段 + 机器人内损失。标准神经介入器械在中间几层导管上短了 20–50 cm。放在 k = 2 的 132 cm 抽吸导管只能到约 79 cm，大约在颈动脉分叉。导丝换成 300 cm 交换长度后都够用。
  5. Substitute devices from other specialties. Clinicians confirmed that for phantom and animal work, a peripheral or cardiac device can replace a neuro device of the same diameter. Radial-to-peripheral (R2P) products are the richest source of long devices: guide sheaths of 149–150 cm and support catheters or microcatheters of 200 cm.借用其他专科的器械。临床医生确认，做模型和动物实验时，同直径的外周或心脏介入器械可以代替神经介入器械。长尺寸器械最多的是桡动脉到外周（R2P）这一类，导引鞘有 149–150 cm，支撑导管和微导管有 200 cm。
  6. Check the coaxial fit. Each inner instrument's OD must fit inside the outer one's ID. We preferred pairs the manufacturer documents as telescoping, such as the Surmodics Sublime 0.018" inside the 0.035" model.检查能否同轴套入。每根内层器械的 OD 都必须小于外层的 ID。我们优先选厂家写明可以互相套用的组合，比如把 Surmodics Sublime 0.018" 套进 0.035" 型号。
  7. Count the slack of longer outer catheters. If an outer catheter is longer than it needs to be, the extra shaft sits between the robot and its hub, and every instrument inside it must travel that extra distance too. So the best outer catheter is the shortest one that still reaches, and each inner instrument must be at least the outer one's length + its protrusion + g + Lm. This is also why a standard coil pusher cannot reach the k=3 module.计入外层导管的余长。外层导管比需要的长时，多出的管身会留在机器人和它的 hub 之间，里面的每根器械都要多走这一段。所以外层导管最好选能到位的最短型号；每根内层器械的长度，至少要等于外层器械长度 + 伸出外层头端的长度 + g + Lm。标准 coil pusher 够不到 k=3 模块，也是这个原因。
  8. Shortlist 2–3 listings per slot on DotMed and medicalmaterials.com that meet the required length, noting price and expiry. Expired stock is acceptable for phantom work; check your protocol before using it in animals.每个位置挑 2–3 个挂牌。在 DotMed 和 medicalmaterials.com 上找满足所需长度的挂牌，记下价格和有效期。模型实验可以用过期器械，用于动物实验前请先确认实验方案的要求。

Gaps found in the search搜索中发现的缺口

No 8F guide catheter of 110 cm or longer. We used a 6F long guide sheath instead (Terumo R2P Destination Slender, 149 cm, ID 0.087").没有 110 cm 以上的 8F 导引导管。我们改用 6F 长导引鞘（Terumo R2P Destination Slender，149 cm，ID 0.087"）。
No large-lumen (≥ 0.070") catheter of 155 cm or longer. The aspiration slot uses 0.035"-lumen catheters, so aspiration force is far lower and clot analogs may need to be softer. The Export AP 140 cm used previously is about 15 cm short at k = 2.没有 155 cm 以上的大腔（≥ 0.070"）导管。抽吸位置只能用 0.035" 内腔的导管，抽吸力小得多，血栓模型可能要做得更软。之前用的 Export AP 140 cm 放在 k = 2 约短 15 cm。
Only one microcatheter family is 190 cm or longer: Surmodics Sublime at 200 cm, and every listing found was expired.190 cm 以上的微导管只找到一个系列：Surmodics Sublime 200 cm，找到的挂牌全部已经过期。
Four-module stacks are not feasible with these devices. Each inner layer must be at least about 31 cm + its protrusion longer than the layer outside it. Thrombectomy with a microcatheter (Set 3) and coiling with a DAC (Set 4) both fail at k=3. Coiling without a DAC (Set 5) works.这些器械组不成 4 模块组合。每一层内层器械至少要比外面一层长约 31 cm，再加上伸出的长度。取栓加微导管（第 3 套）和带 DAC 的栓塞（第 4 套）都在 k=3 这一层不够长。不用 DAC 的栓塞（第 5 套）可行。
Coil pushers are a fixed length. The Boston Coil Pusher-16 (177 cm) and neuro detachable coils (175–190 cm) cannot reach the k=3 module. Use 0.018" pushable coils pushed with a 0.018" × 300 cm wire (Set 5).coil pusher 的长度是固定的。Boston Coil Pusher-16（177 cm）和神经介入用的可解脱弹簧圈（175–190 cm）都够不到 k=3 模块。请改用 0.018" 推送式弹簧圈，用 0.018" × 300 cm 导丝来推（第 5 套）。
The Acuity Whisper 0.014" × 190 cm wire used in the paper is 2 cm short as the k = 3 wire for an average adult.论文里用的 Acuity Whisper 0.014" × 190 cm 导丝放在 k = 3，按平均身材算还短 2 cm。
